descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S22 「Encounter 标签页、全屏记事本和 Post-Round 记录通过 axe（WCAG 2 A/AA），两种模式」 Encounter tab, full-screen notepad and Post-Round note pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Both entry paths reach the same place: 'Begin Encounter' on the Pre-Round tab and the Encounter tab open the same encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate).（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T2 The encounter notepad renders full-size, matching Vikram's app.（TFA-92592 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture; screens hospital-chart-encounter and nh-chart-encounter exist, Post-Round with a note and the full-screen notepad do not

When The visual lane runs axe-core on the Encounter tab, the notepad opened full screen, and Post-Round with a generated note, in both modes

Then No serious or critical violations. Dictate, Save & Extract, Generate and the note-format picker have accessible names; the notepad textarea has a label; the generated note is exposed as a named document

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical; other findings go to a human

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92592 ready for pr

读屏用户在养老院 Encounter 页、全屏记事本和 Post-Round 上听到的返回键没有名字；Copy to EMR、Mark Visit Complete 的颜色对比度不够。

A screen-reader user hears an unnamed button for the Nursing Home back arrow on the Encounter tab, the full-screen notepad and Post-Round, and Copy to EMR and Mark Visit Complete fail colour contrast.

依据：Allure d5c2f5e6, visual lane: 24 checks passed, 18 failed. axe button-name (critical) on the NH back button. Contrast: Copy to EMR 3.66:1, Mark Visit Complete 3.21:1, plus the disabled format chip. Not in dev report §5, which lists other dialogs. The gate TFA-92592 is at ready for pr, but these items are outside that PR.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：encounter.spec.ts: Encounter tab, full-screen notepad, Post-Round with a seeded note and billing (both modes); axe serious/critical; Dictate / Save & Extract / Generate / Note Format names; notepad label; note as a named role=document. [2026-10-14 review] Label rule follows the oracle (axe semantics: a placeholder counts): judged = the notepad has an accessible name; placeholder-only is recorded for a person.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 24 judged check(s) passed, 18 failed. Hospital Encounter: Dictate, Save & Extract, Generate Note & Finish and Note Format named; notepad labelled; the note is a role=document named 'Generated clinical note' in both modes. The NH notepad has an accessible name through its placeholder (passes with axe semantics since the review).

产品问题：NH back button unnamed (axe button-name, critical) on the Encounter tab, the full-screen notepad and Post-Round; contrast (Copy to EMR white on teal 3.66:1, green Mark Visit Complete 3.21:1, the small disabled format chip on the Hospital Encounter). Oracle: zero serious or critical.

只记录的格子（recorded）：Nursing Home encounter notepad (inline and full screen) is named only by its placeholder 'Dictate or type today’s visit: …' (recorded for a person, WCAG 3.3.2).
